module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
        q <= 4'b0000;
    end else if (ena || load) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else begin
            q <= {q[2:0], q[3]};
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output out
);

  wire w1, w2, w3, w4, w5, w6;

  assign w1 = ~(b | c);      // NOR gate (b, c)
  assign w2 = c & d;         // AND gate (c, d)
  assign w3 = ~(a | d);      // NOR gate (a, d)
  assign w4 = ~(c | a);      // NOR gate (c, a)
  assign w5 = w2 & w3;       // AND gate (w2, w3)
  assign w6 = w1 & w4;       // AND gate (w1, w4)
  assign out = w5 | w6;      // OR gate (w5, w6)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

  always @(*) begin
    out = a | ~(b & c);
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);
  always @(*) begin
    out = (c ^ d) ^ (a ^ b);
  end
endmodule
